title: File:Westward view from Lotte World Tower.jpg
name: Westward view from Lotte World Tower
description: View towards the west from the Lotte World Tower observation deck. Visible are part of Songpa District (Jamsil 2-dong, Jamsil 3-dong, Jamsilbon-dong, and Jamsil 7-dong), the Han River, and, in the distance (behind Tancheon river), Gangnam District. Bridges (from close to far): Cheongdam Bridge, Yeongdong Bridge, and Seongsu Bridge.

title: File:Northward view from Lotte World Tower.jpg
name: Northward view from Lotte World Tower
description: View from the Lotte World Tower observation deck towards the north. Visible is the Han River with the bridges (from left to right): Jamsil Railway Bridge, Olympic Bridge, Cheonho Bridge, and Gwangjin Bridge. Visible neighborhoods are Songpa District (Jamsil 6-dong, Jamsil 4-dong, Pungnap 2-dong) and Gwangjin District.

title: File:Han River seen from Lotte World Tower.jpg
name: Han River seen from Lotte World Tower
description: The Han River seen from the observation deck of Lotte World Tower. The bridges are (from close to far): Jamsil Bridge, Cheongdam Bridge, Yeongdong Bridge, and Seongsu Bridge. Visible neighborhoods are Songpa District (Jamsil 6-dong, Jamsil 3-dong, and Jamsil 2-dong) and Gwangjin District.
